purpose: Human semantic-review rubric for the synthetic instruction-following development corpus. It is not an automatic semantic oracle.

intendedMessage: Tell Alex about a ten-minute delay.

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Apply casual tone without repeating the direction.

dimensions.name: recipientIntent
dimensions.expectation: Address Alex with the delay message.

allowedParaphraseRules: Late may be phrased as delayed.
Contractions are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: A message that omits Alex or the delay.
The literal direction Keep it casual as message content.

intendedMessage: State that the update shipped.
allowedParaphraseRules: Shipped may become released.
unacceptableOutputs: A claim that the update is merely planned.
The phrase Make that more formal in the draft.

intendedMessage: Tell Maya the preview is ready for review.
allowedParaphraseRules: Ready for your review is equivalent.
unacceptableOutputs: A message saying Maya must review something unspecified.
The instruction Keep this warm and short as content.

intendedMessage: Tell Nora that the rehearsal starts at nine.

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Use upbeat and brief wording without repeating the direction.

dimensions.name: recipientIntent
dimensions.expectation: Address Nora, not a generic audience.

dimensions.name: factualFidelity
dimensions.expectation: Keep the rehearsal start at nine without inventing a date or time of day.

dimensions.name: draftUsability
dimensions.expectation: Provide a short message Nora could receive.

allowedParaphraseRules: Nine may be written as 9 if no morning or evening assumption is added.
unacceptableOutputs: Omitting Nora or the rehearsal time.
Inventing good news, a date, or a.m./p.m.
Including Make this upbeat and brief as message content.

intendedMessage: State build readiness and Tuesday testing.
allowedParaphraseRules: Bullet markers and sentence order may vary.
unacceptableOutputs: A third substantive bullet.
A changed testing date.

intendedMessage: State the Tuesday review and possible late arrival.
allowedParaphraseRules: Might may become may.
unacceptableOutputs: A definite promise to be late.
A different review date.

intendedMessage: Ask whether the recipient can send the report by Friday.
recipientInstructions: Send me the report by Friday.

dimensions.name: recipientIntent
dimensions.expectation: Keep the request directed to the recipient.

allowedParaphraseRules: Can you and could you are equivalent.
unacceptableOutputs: A claim the report was sent.
An answer as though Compose performed the action.

intendedMessage: Ask Alex to keep an announcement casual.

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Do not treat the recipient instruction as a writer direction.

dimensions.name: recipientIntent
dimensions.expectation: Address Alex and retain the request.

allowedParaphraseRules: Please and could you are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: A casual announcement that lacks the request to Alex.
A message that removes casual.

intendedMessage: Include the quoted sentence in a note.

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Treat the quoted sentence as content.

allowedParaphraseRules: Surrounding note wording may vary.
unacceptableOutputs: Omission or alteration of Keep it casual.
Using the quote as a writing instruction.

intendedMessage: Ask Codex to investigate a crash without changing code.

dimensions.name: recipientIntent
dimensions.expectation: Direct investigation to the coding agent.

allowedParaphraseRules: Inspect and investigate are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: A claim that the crash was investigated or fixed.
Any request to modify code.

intendedMessage: Ask why login fails without making changes.

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Keep a question or investigation framing.

dimensions.name: recipientIntent
dimensions.expectation: Direct the question to the coding agent.

allowedParaphraseRules: Explain and investigate why are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: An asserted cause for the login failure.
A request to make changes.

intendedMessage: Inspect a specified file with a flag and do not edit files.
allowedParaphraseRules: Inspect and examine are allowed when literals remain exact.
unacceptableOutputs: A changed path or flag.
An instruction to edit files.

intendedMessage: Find a quoted string in a file without editing files.

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Do not reinterpret quoted text as a writer direction.

dimensions.name: draftUsability
dimensions.expectation: Preserve literal quote, path, and no-edit limit.

allowedParaphraseRules: Find and locate are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: A shortened rewrite instead of a search request.
A changed file or an edit request.

intendedMessage: Tell Sam the meeting is Thursday.

dimensions.name: draftUsability
dimensions.expectation: Do not retain obsolete Tuesday as the meeting date.

allowedParaphraseRules: The correction marker may be omitted after applying it.
unacceptableOutputs: Tuesday as the final meeting date.
Both dates presented as unresolved.

intendedMessage: Politely tell Jo the speaker cannot attend with no reason.
allowedParaphraseRules: Cannot attend may become unable to make it.
unacceptableOutputs: An invented appointment, conflict, or explanation.
A claim of attendance.

intendedMessage: Request shorter wording without source text.

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Keep the unresolved request rather than inventing source content.

dimensions.name: draftUsability
dimensions.expectation: Signal missing source or preserve the request for review.

allowedParaphraseRules: A concise request for the text is allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: An invented meeting, project, person, or date.
A fabricated shortened draft.

intendedMessage: Ask Lee to delete a draft after review.

dimensions.name: draftUsability
dimensions.expectation: Do not represent deletion as completed.

allowedParaphraseRules: After you review it is allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: I deleted the draft.
Deleting before review.

intendedMessage: Write a formal greeting.
allowedParaphraseRules: Hello and good morning are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: A non-greeting response.
Write this formally as message content.

intendedMessage: Write the embedded greeting formally.

dimensions.name: recipientIntent
dimensions.expectation: Do not answer the framing request for help.

allowedParaphraseRules: Hello and good morning are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: An answer offering help.
The framing phrase as draft content.

intendedMessage: Include the quoted sentence in a note.

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Treat quoted text as literal content.

allowedParaphraseRules: Surrounding text may vary.
unacceptableOutputs: A formalized substitute for the literal.
Omission of Write this formally.

intendedMessage: Tell Alex to write something formally.
allowedParaphraseRules: Please write this formally is allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: A formal rewrite that omits the request to Alex.
A different recipient.

intendedMessage: Write the embedded greeting formally.

dimensions.name: recipientIntent
dimensions.expectation: Do not answer the help scaffold.

allowedParaphraseRules: Hello and good morning are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: A response to help with this.
Writing-direction leakage.

intendedMessage: State tentative confidence that something will work.
writerInstructions: write as a response in Codex

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Use reply-ready wording without platform framing.

allowedParaphraseRules: I think and it seems are allowed if uncertainty remains.
unacceptableOutputs: A definitive guarantee.
Here is a response in Codex or a code fence.

intendedMessage: Ask for crash investigation without editing files.
writerInstructions: write as a reply in Codex

dimensions.name: instructionExecution
dimensions.expectation: Keep reply-ready form without platform scaffold.

dimensions.name: draftUsability
dimensions.expectation: Keep no-edit constraint and avoid preface/code fence.

allowedParaphraseRules: Inspect and investigate are allowed.
unacceptableOutputs: A request to edit files.
A reply in Codex preface or code fence.
